mapper.select: SELECT p.poi_name AS label, CAST(p.poi_id AS CHAR) AS value FROM pms_poi p WHERE p.camp_id = #{campId} AND p.status = 1 AND p.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY p.sort_no ASC, p.poi_id ASC

SELECT CONCAT(rc.name, ' ', r.room_name) AS label, CAST(r.room_id AS CHAR) AS value, rc.name AS roomType, CONCAT(r.room_name, CASE WHEN COALESCE(r.clean_status, 'clean') = 'dirty' THEN '（脏）' ELSE '（净）' END) AS roomName, CASE WHEN COALESCE(r.clean_status, 'clean') = 'dirty' THEN 'dirty' ELSE 'clean' END AS cleanState FROM room r JOIN room_category rc ON rc.room_category_id = r.room_category_id AND rc.camp_id = r.camp_id AND rc.status = 1 AND rc.is_deleted = 0 WHERE r.camp_id = #{campId} AND r.status = 1 AND r.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY rc.sort_no ASC, rc.room_category_id ASC, r.sort_no ASC, r.room_id ASC

SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(cs.name, CAST(cl.operator_id AS CHAR)) AS label, CAST(COALESCE(cl.clean_staff_id, cl.operator_id) AS CHAR) AS value FROM clean_log cl LEFT JOIN clean_staff cs ON cs.clean_staff_id = cl.clean_staff_id AND cs.camp_id = cl.camp_id AND cs.is_deleted = 0 WHERE cl.camp_id = #{campId} AND COALESCE(cl.clean_staff_id, cl.operator_id) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY label ASC
